quest.title: Narcissus's Waltz
quest.description: Go to the hidden dwelling, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with the guests...

talks.objective: Go to the hidden dwelling to start the tea party
Go to the hidden dwelling to start the tea party

dialogues.speaker: Ann
dialogues.text: Seymour! It's been so long! And Mamere too!

dialogues.speaker: Mamere
dialogues.text: Hehe, Seymour wouldn't stop telling me how much he missed you.

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: Affirmative. I never stopped thinking of Miss Mary-Ann.

dialogues.speaker: Mary-Ann
dialogues.text: And thank you, Miss Sandrone, for hosting this tea party. It's so nice to get together and chat about our travels.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Don't mention it. I feel like we're all family on some level, with a long, shared history. Uhm, at least that's how I see it. So there's no harm in getting together when everyone's free.

dialogues.speaker: Ann
dialogues.text: Family? I don't know why, but hearing you say that fills me with joy.

dialogues.speaker: Mary-Ann
dialogues.text: So does that make Miss Sandrone our... little sister?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Uhm... Maybe we can skip the whole big, little thing for now...?

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: Affirmative. As the prototype created by Mr. Alain, Miss Sandrone should properly address me as "Big Brother."

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Hmph...

dialogues.speaker: Mamere
dialogues.text: Aw, that's so lovely. Can I be a member of this family, too?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Of course! We're hardly a conventional "family" to begin with. What harm could adding a Melusine to the mix do?

dialogues.speaker: Seymour
dialogues.text: Affirmative. Besides, Miss Mamere is already my family.

dialogues.speaker: Mamere
dialogues.text: Hehe. This makes me so happy! How about I paint us all a family portrait?

dialogues.speaker: Mary-Ann
dialogues.text: A family portrait? It's been a long time since I posed for one of those...

dialogues.speaker: Ann
dialogues.text: Make sure to make me look impressive! Like the big sister of the family!

dialogues.speaker: Mamere
dialogues.text: Sure thing!

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Heh... Why not?

dialogues.speaker: Mary-Ann
dialogues.text: Such a peaceful, pleasant day.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: (Let's sit like this for a little while longer.)

dialogues.speaker: Mary-Ann
dialogues.text: Mmhmm, thank you for the invitation, Sandrone... Or should I call you "little sister"?
